title: Railway button
description: Developer-console buttons with small radii and hairline borders: a muted violet primary with a lighter violet edge, a near-black one, a faint outline, a ghost nav button, and a magenta-to-violet radial button whose glow doubles on hover.
notes: made for dark themes; the glow variant mixes the theme's glow and chart-1 colours
name: railway-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: muted violet with a lighter violet hairline · dark: near-black with a hairline ·
outline: faint fill and a brighter hairline · ghost: no fill until hovered ·
glow: a radial gradient from the glow colour to chart-1 with a soft glow that doubles on hover

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 36px nav-sized · md: 44px · lg: 58px hero-sized with 20px text
